rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an organized team, especially at work or in a project.

example.english: Our team has to hand in a report tomorrow.
example.traditional: 我哋團隊聽日要交份報告。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 tyun4 deoi6 ting1 jat6 jiu3 gaau1 fan6 bou3 gou3

rows.note: Use this shorter everyday word especially for a sports team or a team someone plays on.

example.jyutping: nei5 zi1 ci4 bin1 deoi6 aa3

rows.note: Use this for one of two opposing sides in a debate rather than for an organized team.

example.english: In the debate, the team arguing for higher taxes said this could improve people's livelihoods.
example.traditional: 辯論入面，支持加稅嘅一方話咁樣可以改善民生。
example.jyutping: bin6 leon6 jap6 min6 zi1 ci4 gaa1 seoi3 ge3 jat1 fong1 waa6 gam2 joeng6 ho2 ji5 goi2 sin6 man4 sang1
